summary:
How can we explore the universe in an easier and more interactive way?
This is where SPHERO SKY comes in — a platform designed to bring space data closer to users.
Discover the electromagnetic spectrum and explore the role of infrared light observed by NASA’s SPHEREx mission, which reveals information that our eyes cannot see directly.
Through an interactive interface, we explore images of the sky and compare observations, making astronomical data easier to explore and understand.
SPHERO SKY — Explore the sky, compare observations, and start with a scientific question.
details:
Welcome to SPHERO SKY! For the NASA SPHEREx challenge, we didn’t just build a website — we built an interactive journey into the universe, powered by the science of space exploration.


Have you ever wondered what lies beyond what our eyes can see? SPHERO SKY brings you closer to the hidden universe by exploring the electromagnetic spectrum and discovering the power of infrared light observed by NASA’s SPHEREx mission.


But this isn’t just about looking at space — it’s about exploring it. Through our interactive platform, users can discover the infrared region of the spectrum, explore images of the sky, and compare observations to uncover how the universe can be studied in different ways.


By transforming complex astronomical concepts into an accessible visual experience, we make space science easier to explore, understand, and enjoy.


This is space data in a whole new way — not just numbers and scientific reports, but an interactive journey that inspires curiosity and turns every observation into a new question.


SPHERO SKY — Explore the sky, compare observations, and discover the universe beyond what you can see.

 

Exploring the universe can be challenging when astronomical data is complex and difficult to understand. Making space science more accessible through interactive tools and visual comparisons can help users better understand how scientists observe and study the universe.


SPHERO SKY addresses this challenge by providing an interactive platform that introduces the electromagnetic spectrum, highlights the role of infrared light in NASA’s SPHERE x mission, and allows users to explore sky images and compare observations. By transforming astronomical concepts into a visual and engaging experience, the platform aims to make space exploration easier to understand and inspire curiosity about the universe.


Our goal is to bridge the gap between complex space science and everyday users, turning astronomical exploration into an accessible, interactive learning experience.

 

Detailed Project Description — SPHERO SKY


SPHERO SKY is an interactive web platform designed to make space exploration more accessible, engaging, and easier to understand. The project aims to bridge the gap between complex astronomical data and everyday users by transforming scientific concepts into a visual and interactive learning experience.


Inspired by NASA’s SPHERE x mission, which surveys the entire sky in near-infrared light across 102 spectral bands, SPHERO SKY introduces users to the electromagnetic spectrum and explains how infrared observations reveal information about the universe that is invisible to the human eye.


The platform features an interactive visualization of the electromagnetic spectrum, helping users understand the different types of electromagnetic radiation and the position of infrared light within it. It also provides a visual environment where users can explore images of the sky and compare astronomical observations taken at different times, encouraging them to observe differences and ask scientific questions.


By combining visual learning, image comparison, and accessible scientific explanations, SPHERO SKY aims to simplify astronomical concepts and encourage curiosity about the universe. Rather than presenting space science through complex charts and technical reports alone, the platform offers an intuitive experience that allows users to engage with astronomical information in a more meaningful way.


Our vision is to make the universe easier to explore, inspire the next generation of space enthusiasts, and demonstrate how NASA’s open science resources can support interactive learning and scientific discovery.


SPHERO SKY — Explore the sky, compare observations, and discover the universe beyond what you can see.
